channel.title: Antash Mishra
channel.description: Writing by Antash Mishra: notes from building things.

item.title: Torchlight 0.1: a launcher for Linux that answers in under 5 ms
item.description: Releasing Torchlight, a Spotlight-style launcher for Linux written in C: forgiving search over apps, settings and half a million files, a quiet daemon, and a popup that looks like teletext.

item.title: From Marching Squares to Marching Cubes
item.description: A visual exploration of marching cubes, starting with the smaller 2D idea of marching squares and building up to surface extraction in 3D.

item.title: Building a Tiny 3D Dataset Instead of Downloading a Giant One
item.description: The first Tiny3D-Latent devlog: starting a native-3D generation project by building a small procedural voxel dataset from scratch.

item.title: Finetuning Qwen STT Model for Hindi Language
item.description: Fine-tuning Qwen 0.6B with LoRA on 5 hours of Hindi speech data — dropping WER from 31% to 24.67% while keeping sub-250ms latency for Vaani.
